tasks.subject: Task 5: Building a fill into a document
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `CsArea` can create and clear an area's fill in a real drawing — scatter as block references, filled as a hatch — every entity tagged with its owner.

**Files:**
- Modify: `scripts/CaveSurvey/Core/CsArea.js`
- Create: `tests/area_fill_run.js`
- Modify: `tests/run_all.sh` (register the new suite and bump the count in its banner)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `CsArea.vertsOf(entity)` samples a closed spline or polyline into `[{x,y}, ...]`
- [ ] `CsArea.build(doc, op, boundary, entry, opts)` adds block references for a scatter pattern, each on `opts.layer`, each tagged `AreaOwner = <area id>`
- [ ] For a filled pattern it adds exactly one `RHatchEntity` with one loop, tagged the same way
- [ ] For `BEDROCK` it adds nothing and reports success
- [ ] `CsArea.clear(doc, op, areaId)` deletes every entity tagged with that owner and nothing else — a second area's fill survives
- [ ] Regenerating twice leaves the same entity count (idempotence)
